verifyNotes: Confirm against the official exam page (nvidia.com/en-us/learn/certification/agentic-ai-professional/) and the official study guide PDF (https://dam-cdn.nvd.orangelogic.com/AssetLink/64tei188l3tt132l265u1ipjoexdl1p5.pdf): 120 minutes, 60–70 questions, $200, English, online remotely proctored via Certiverse, valid two years, pass/fail with no published score. The page marks the exam 'Coming soon' while showing a registration link: report the true status. The exam page and study guide disagree on weights (page: Deployment and Scaling 13%, Run/Monitor/Maintain 5%; guide: 5% and 7%); report both and use the exam page values. Use the study guide's numbered subtopics (1.1 etc.) and its recommended courses and readings. Use current names: NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit (formerly Agent Intelligence Toolkit / AgentIQ), NIM, NIM Agent Blueprints / AI Blueprints, NeMo Guardrails, NeMo Retriever, Triton, TensorRT-LLM, Dynamo. Also cover framework-neutral concepts (ReAct, tool calling, MCP, A2A, LangGraph-style orchestration). Never copy official sample questions.
name: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI
audience: AI engineers with 1–3 years in AI/ML and hands-on production agent projects
format: 60–70 questions in 120 minutes; online remotely proctored (Certiverse); English. Pass/fail; NVIDIA publishes no passing score, so this site uses 700 on a 100–1000 scale for its mocks.
scenarios: Employee IT-help agent with tool calling
Customer-service voice agent built from a blueprint
Research agent over a knowledge graph

domains.name: Agent Architecture and Design
skills: Reactive, deliberative and hybrid architectures; ReAct and reasoning-action loops; logic trees, prompt chains and stateful orchestration
Multi-agent orchestration and agent-to-agent communication protocols; knowledge graphs; human-agent UI design; adaptable, scalable architecture

domains.name: Agent Development
skills: Prompt engineering and dynamic prompt chains; integrating multimodal models; building custom tools, APIs and functions
Error handling: retries, circuit breakers, graceful recovery; streaming conversation flows with feedback; refining decision strategies

domains.name: Evaluation and Tuning
skills: Evaluation pipelines and task benchmarks; comparing agents across tasks and datasets; NeMo Agent Toolkit evaluation and profiling
Structured user feedback; tuning accuracy vs latency and cost; analysing results for targeted optimisation

domains.name: Deployment and Scaling
skills: Deploy multi-agent systems at scale with containers, Kubernetes and load balancing; NIM microservices
MLOps CI/CD and governance for agents; profiling under distributed load; cost and availability optimisation

domains.name: Cognition, Planning, and Memory
skills: Planning and decomposition strategies, chain-of-thought, reflection and self-correction
Short- and long-term memory, context management, state persistence across multi-turn tasks

domains.name: Knowledge Integration and Data Handling
skills: RAG pipelines for agents: retrieval, embeddings, reranking, vector databases, NeMo Retriever; knowledge graphs
Handling structured, unstructured and multimodal data; data quality and freshness

domains.name: NVIDIA Platform Implementation
skills: NIM, NeMo Agent Toolkit, NeMo Guardrails, AI Blueprints, Triton, TensorRT-LLM: when to use each and how they fit together on NVIDIA GPUs

domains.name: Run, Monitor, and Maintain
skills: Observability, logging and tracing of agent runs; troubleshooting hallucinations and tool failures; maintenance and updates

domains.name: Safety, Ethics, and Compliance
skills: Guardrails, prompt-injection defence, bias detection, privacy preservation, regulatory compliance and audit

domains.name: Human-AI Interaction and Oversight
skills: Human-in-the-loop approval, escalation, transparency and explainability to users, oversight controls
